prompt: Render a table of statistics from a JSON file using Astro’s data fetching, styled with CSS modules.
criterion: Table renders data from JSON file correctly with CSS modules applied; no client-side JavaScript used.

prompt: Build a product catalog page using Astro and Markdown files, each with price, image, and description in frontmatter.
criterion: Catalog renders all products with correct frontmatter data; no JavaScript used for rendering or filtering.

prompt: Use Astro’s partial hydration to render a live clock island that updates every second, while the rest of the page remains static.
criterion: Clock updates every second in the island; page loads without JS and other content remains static.

prompt: Build a pagination component for a blog listing that loads 5 posts per page using Astro’s page context.
criterion: Pagination correctly displays 5 posts per page with functional prev/next links and no client-side JS.

prompt: Create an Astro site with a homepage displaying three blog previews from Markdown files, using frontmatter for titles and dates, and link each to its full page.
criterion: Homepage correctly renders three blog previews with titles, dates, and functional links to individual Markdown pages.

prompt: Create a 404 page in Astro that uses a custom layout imported from a shared component and includes a link back to the homepage.
criterion: 404 page renders with correct layout and functional homepage link; no client-side JavaScript used.

prompt: Integrate a React component into an Astro page that renders a modal dialog, ensuring it only hydrates on user interaction.
criterion: Modal component renders and hydrates only after user interaction; page loads without React JS initially.

prompt: Implement a navigation bar in Astro that dynamically lists all pages from the /pages directory using Astro’s content collections.
criterion: Navigation bar automatically populates with all page titles and correct hrefs without hardcoded links.

prompt: Create a site-wide footer component in Astro that includes social links pulled from a global config file.
criterion: Footer renders social links from config file correctly; no client-side logic or hydration used.

prompt: Use Astro’s islands to add a counter component that increments on click, while keeping the rest of the page static.
criterion: Counter increments on click with no rehydration or JS on other page elements; page loads without JS by default.
